title: Concept: Dependency declared with an open lower bound
description: package.json declares a `>=` specifier with no upper bound, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every future major release satisfies the declaration, so an incompatible or compromised release is installed without a manifest change.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Every future major release satisfies the declaration, so an incompatible or compromised release is installed without a manifest change.
